title: THE TOP 10 AI APPS FOR SUMMER 2024! The best hour you will spend all summer
description: Send us Fan Mail Heading to the beach this summer? Or just staying at home pondering how long it will be until a superintelligent AI takes over the world? Or maybe you really want to learn the best AI tools to use this summer? Well whatever your flava you are in the right place, because this week Jimmy and Matt introduce their top 10 AI applications for summer 2024! Join us to discover the best large language models for multimodality, search and privacy, the best image and music generation tools, the most comprehensive Chinese multimodal AI app and the best place for interactive AI learning. It might just be the best hour you will spend all summer. Suno Perplexity ChatGPT Private, Permissionless AI (venice.ai) Claude Groq is Fast AI Inference Superintelligent AI — Get Great at AI (besuper.ai) The AI Daily Brief (Formerly The AI Breakdown): Artificial Intelligence News and Analysis on Apple Podcasts Search Microsoft Copilot: Your everyday AI companion AI Supremacy | Michael Spencer | Substack (ai-supremacy.com) Don't Worry About the Vase | Substack Luma Dream Machine (lumalabs.ai) 天工AI-搜索、对话、写作、文档分析、画画、做PPT的全能AI助手 (tiangong.cn)
summary: Jimmy and Matt list their ten favourite AI apps for summer 2024, no ranking attached: Suno, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Venice, Groq, AI news sources (AI Daily Brief, AI Supremacy, Don't Worry About the Vase), Copilot, Superintelligent, Dream Machine, Tiangong, plus a shout-out to Claude 3.5 Sonnet. It is both a recommendations episode and a snapshot of the mid-2024 consumer AI landscape.
keyTalkingPoints: Suno 3.5 powers every podcast outro — free tier included, commercial rights only on paid, and Claude writes the lyrics
Perplexity is Matt's search-engine replacement: answers with linked sources, five free pro searches a day
Venice.ai offers privacy-first, no-storage access to open models for $49 a year — though the hosts question any model claiming no bias
Groq (with a Q) delivers near-instant inference on custom chips, making other models feel like cassette tapes
Claude 3.5 Sonnet is their consensus pick as the best all-round model — more natural, funnier, and free

jimmy: Suno is taking livelihoods but will not replace musicians — it lacks spirit, though it is enormous fun
Google search has become a mess of ads; Perplexity is the replacement
Inference-specialised chips like Groq's will deliver 100x efficiency gains and massive cost and energy savings
Claude 3.5 Sonnet is the best model available and his default for everything
matt: Perplexity genuinely replaces search for most people — sources linked, no SEO quagmire
Venice's privacy-first, no-storage model is a bargain at $49 a year for the privacy-conscious
Free tiers are enough for most users — Copilot executing PowerPoint commands will be the real game changer
Chinese apps like Tiangong show the most multimodal ambition in one place, hampered by censorship
